- No visual artifact inspection applicable: backend-only change with no UI/visual output.

Blocking QA findings:
1. Ambiguous/foreign backlink mismatches are not refused. AdmitTaskRecovery treats every !IsValid checkout identically and calls RecoverWorktree (apps/backend/internal/worktree/manager.go:216-227), which snapshots, creates a sibling worktree, and CAS-retargets the durable row (recovery.go:60-123). The backlink-mismatch test only asserts IsValid=false (manager_test.go:310-333); it never proves admission refuses without checkout/admin/ref/row mutation. This conflicts with AC7 and the foreign/ambiguous refusal boundary.
2. The preflight is a boolean pointer/admin/backlink check only (manager_state.go:253-304). It does not classify healthy/missing-admin/backlink-mismatch/ambiguous as a typed result, validate commondir, HEAD/ref/OID, remote containment, expected common repository, workspace ID, repository ID, or the full durable identity required by AC1/AC2/AC4. RecoverWorktree validates task ID and a task-root marker but does not prove req.RepositoryID/RepositoryPath against the durable record before metadata work (recovery.go:60-69).
3. Snapshot/restore proof is incomplete for AC3/AC5/AC6/AC8. checkoutManifest omits directories entirely (recovery.go:368-389), so empty directories and directory modes are neither inventoried nor verified; recovery records no original .git marker bytes, resolved HEAD/ref/OID, or remote containment. restoreSnapshot validates the snapshot before copy but does not compare the destination manifest after copy or re-read the original after rematerialization (recovery.go:425-429). The real-Git recovery regression checks one untracked file and IsValid only (manager_test.go:434-485); it does not assert git status --porcelain, git log -1, tracked modifications/deletions, ignored files, executable modes, symlinks, full pre/post manifest identity, or concurrent-write refusal.
